corrections.text: The article quotes The Hacker News as writing, "No active exploitation reports accompanied the advisory, and no workarounds exist for unpatched systems." This exact sentence does not appear in The Hacker News article. The source instead states, in separate sentences, "The advisory does not report any attacks using the flaws" and "It lists no workaround for servers that cannot update yet." The substance attributed to the source is accurate, but the quoted sentence was not reproduced verbatim.
